scope: All ten BioAgent source questions reviewed for missing stages, complete output artifacts and independent observed-data adaptations. No implementation or new coverage.

source.source_boundary: Question metadata and scorer control flow only; no benchmark data/result archive downloaded or used. Source fixed-answer literals are not adopted into task authoring.

shared_acceptance_rules: One coherent task per recipe, one corpus train split; preserve the original question IDs and coverage states.
Each independent input manifest must pin accession, file hash, rights, biological units, real observation scale and benchmark-lineage exclusions.
Oracles must read the actual packaged input and run the native analysis. Keep reference outputs and benchmark truth private.

Every required output needs complete unique keys, exact categorical/identity checks, explicit missing-value semantics and prespecified numerical tolerances. Set numerical tolerances from method scale/repeatability, never from a solver answer.
Native learned/stochastic outputs may need invariant or held-out performance criteria; freeze the criterion and baseline before solver runs.
A passing weak source result scorer is not a full workflow check. Grade all requested calculations and artifacts without a model judge.
Measure the complete offline solve/reference path below 30 minutes; narrower start boundaries preserve explicit uncovered upstream stages.

questions.scientific_question: Which pathways recur across three independently observed biological models after model-specific expression contrasts and identifier reconciliation?
required_endpoint_stages: audit sample, model and gene identities
fit each replicated model/control expression contrast
define each eligible-gene background and directional selected set
run species-appropriate KEGG enrichment
join every pathway across all three models and assess shared evidence
observed_input_requirements: Three independently observed model/control count experiments with actual biological replication, model labels, tissue/age/sex/batch metadata and a compatible pinned pathway mapping. Study and model effects must remain distinguishable.
proposed_artifact_requirements: samples.tsv: sample_id, study_id, model_id, condition, biological_unit, covariates, eligible, exclusion_reason
gene_effects.tsv: model_id, gene_id, eligible, base_mean, effect, standard_error, p_value, q_value, selected, direction
pathway_members.tsv: model_id, pathway_id, gene_id, in_background, selected, mapping_status
pathway_results.tsv: model_id, pathway_id, tested, background_size, set_size, selected_size, overlap, p_value, q_value
shared_pathways.tsv: pathway_id, model_a_p, model_b_p, model_c_p, model_a_q, model_b_q, model_c_q, shared_decision, missing_reason
source_specific_decisions: Exactly three models and their observed control groups; do not treat three technical subsets of one model as three experiments.
Gene namespace and cross-species mapping, separate background universes, count filtering, model design, shrinkage, directional criterion, enrichment test and multiplicity family.
Define shared support before seeing results; missing/untestable differs from nonsignificance. Freeze which quantity the source pvalue columns represent.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run DESeq2 on each actual design and a pinned KEGG enrichment method on the exact mapped sets.
Independently reconstruct eligibility, gene/set counts and pathway joins; recompute enrichment and FDR from complete tables. Grade all three model columns, not one overlapping pathway name.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Replace one model column with another.
Change a background membership while preserving the reported shared pathway.
Omit nonsignificant or untestable pathways.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: The original asks for three specific disease models. An independent three-model study transfers the comparison workflow but does not validate its original disease-specific conclusion.
The existing GSE60450 mammary data does not supply three disease models. Source organism/annotation mismatches cannot be copied into the authored analysis.
questions.independent_input_decision: Select three observed model/control datasets with a coherent shared biological comparison and compatible annotation; identify benchmark-study exclusions before download.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Use preprocessed observed counts with intact biological samples; pin local pathway snapshots. Three complete count fits and enrichment runs need a measured combined runtime below 30 minutes.

questions.scientific_question: Which coding ortholog clusters are conserved across four independently observed related genomes, what annotations support them, and how do their gene trees relate?
required_endpoint_stages: extract phase- and strand-correct coding proteins
identify homologous clusters and resolve paralogs
filter coding clusters present in all four genomes
reconcile high-confidence functional annotations and export the consensus rule
align retained clusters and infer gene trees
report conserved functional modules with their defining evidence
observed_input_requirements: Four independently observed, related annotated genomes as matching FASTA and GFF3 with sequence/version correspondence; deposited coding/functional annotations plus independent local reference evidence. Supplied alignments or trees cannot replace extraction and ortholog discovery.
proposed_artifact_requirements: genes.tsv: genome_id, gene_id, transcript_id, seqid, strand, phase, protein_id, extraction_status
cluster_members.tsv: cluster_id, genome_id, protein_id, copy_number, coding, annotation_id, evidence_class, eligible
clusters.tsv: cluster_id, genomes_present, paralog_status, high_confidence, retained, exclusion_reason, consensus_annotation
alignments/: every retained cluster FASTA and any trimming map
trees/: every retained cluster Newick with leaf/protein map and inference parameters
modules.tsv: module_id, cluster_id, grouping_rule, evidence_id
source_specific_decisions: Four genomes, representative-isoform policy, homology thresholds, ortholog/paralog definition and annotation confidence hierarchy.
Do not equate BUSCO completeness with exhaustive conserved functional-cluster discovery. BUSCO may supply a separate endpoint required by another card.
Define consensus ties, missing annotations and module grouping; a gene tree alone does not prove co-evolution.
deterministic_verification_approach: Execute extraction, native homology search/clustering, alignment and tree inference; consume the actual FASTA/GFF/annotation evidence.
Independently check translation, all-genome membership, coding/confidence filters and deterministic consensus annotations; compare cluster membership and tree splits under declared label symmetries.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Return conserved clusters without consensus annotations.
Retain a cluster absent from one genome or containing only a pseudogene.
Replace orthology with all BLAST hits or use cluster numbers as exact biological identities.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: The source functional-module wording lacks a complete co-evolution statistic. Preserve this as an unresolved endpoint until a justified explicit grouping rule is established.
Matched precomputed ortholog/tree metrics only cover downstream components; they do not complete this task.
questions.independent_input_decision: Choose four independently deposited compact related genomes with coherent annotation evidence; reject source genomes and unrelated phage mixtures.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Package pinned homology references and indexes offline. Bound the number of complete compact genomes and supported coding loci without removing paralog or missing-annotation cases; measure the full discovery-to-tree path.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed variants remain consistent with an independently documented recessive pedigree after genotype QC, segregation and transcript-aware evidence reconciliation?
required_endpoint_stages: validate family/sample identity and genotype quality
normalize allele representations and reconcile callable sites
test recessive segregation and compound-heterozygote phase where claimed
annotate all eligible alleles and transcripts
rank candidates under prespecified evidence rules and retain contradictions/unknowns
observed_input_requirements: Observed family VCFs, a documented multigeneration pedigree and independently recorded phenotype status, matching reference/transcripts and a frozen clinical annotation snapshot. Genotypes or phenotypes must not be planted to force a causal answer.
proposed_artifact_requirements: samples.tsv: sample_id, pedigree_id, mother_id, father_id, phenotype, sex_or_ploidy_basis, callable, eligible
variants.vcf.gz: complete normalized calls and genotype/filter fields
segregation.tsv: variant_key, family_id, inheritance_model, affected_support, unaffected_conflict, phase_support, status
consequences.tsv: variant_key, transcript_id, gene_id, consequence, impact, hgvs_c, hgvs_p, annotation_version
evidence.tsv: variant_key, source_accession, assertion_date, condition, clinical_significance, review_status, conflict
candidates.tsv: variant_key, rank, rule_id, included, exclusion_reason, evidence_status
source_specific_decisions: Reference build, normalization, genotype quality/missingness, sex/ploidy, recessive/compound-heterozygote rules and phenotype uncertainty.
Transcript selection, penetrance assumptions, clinical assertion dates/conflicts and candidate ties. Keep all source-required identity/HGVS/evidence columns.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run native variant normalization and transcript annotation on the observed inputs; apply explicit genotype/pedigree rules.
Independently reconstruct every family segregation decision, allele key, transcript consequence and evidence join; grade all candidates and exclusions.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Treat missing genotypes as reference.
Declare two variants in trans without phasing evidence.
Return a known gene name while dropping genotype conflicts or transcript identity.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: The source adds an artificial disease allele to real family sequence data. This synthetic causal construction cannot be carried into an all-observed task.
Segregation consistency is not proof of disease causality. An open generic reference trio lacking observed phenotype can cover QC/segregation only, not the full disease-identification endpoint.
questions.independent_input_decision: Find legally reusable independent observed family genotypes plus phenotype and causal evidence; otherwise retain full causal identification as an explicit coverage gap.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Use a coherent observed targeted/exome region with complete pedigree genotypes and local annotation; document any reduced search space rather than presenting it as whole-genome causal discovery.

questions.scientific_question: Which gene-level condition effects follow when independently observed replicated RNA reads are aligned, counted and fit with DESeq2?
required_endpoint_stages: validate read pairing and library QC
align reads to the declared genome
assign reads/fragments to annotated genes
fit the explicit DESeq2 condition design
export every gene effect, raw p-value, adjusted p-value and eligibility decision
observed_input_requirements: Observed paired RNA FASTQ for genuinely replicated conditions, sample metadata and matching genome FASTA/GTF. Counts-only input does not exercise the source read-to-count stages.
proposed_artifact_requirements: reads.tsv: sample_id, source_run, pair_count, qc_pass, strandedness, biological_unit
alignment_qc.tsv: sample_id, total, mapped, multimapped, assigned, unassigned, policy
counts.tsv: gene_id and one integer-count column per sample
design.tsv and contrasts.tsv: full model columns and coefficient weights
gene_effects.tsv: gene_id, testable, log2FoldChange, standard_error, statistic, pvalue, padj, exclusion_reason
source_specific_decisions: Library orientation, aligner/reference version, multimapping/overlap/paired-fragment assignment and annotation feature level.
Biological design and contrast sign, low-count filter, DESeq2 settings, shrinkage/reporting policy, independent filtering and NA policy.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run native read QC, aligner, gene counter and DESeq2 end to end.
Independently check sample/pair counts, gene assignment totals, model rank, full result universe and multiplicity; accepting five gene IDs alone is insufficient.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Substitute input count matrices without processing FASTQ.
Swap condition labels or count mates twice.
Return the right gene IDs with corrupted fold changes or p-values.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: The source uses a specific fungal condition comparison. An independent benign organism/condition adaptation preserves analysis stages but needs explicit biological-scope disclosure.
Subsampling reads may reduce power; preserve real biological replicates and do not guarantee a selected number of significant genes.
questions.independent_input_decision: Choose independent compact-genome replicated RNA libraries with documented strandedness and matching annotation, excluding source runs.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Provide the offline reference index and bound whole-library read subsets by a declared reproducible policy, not by outcome. Retain all biological samples; measure alignment plus counting plus model runtime.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed changes relative to an ancestor are shared by two independently sequenced descendant lines and meet a declared consequence threshold?
required_endpoint_stages: audit lineage/read identities and existing preprocessing
align ancestor and descendant reads
perform native haploid probabilistic variant calling
normalize and filter calls within joint callable territory
subtract supported ancestral alleles and intersect the two descendants
annotate retained alleles and apply the declared consequence filter
observed_input_requirements: Observed paired reads from one documented ancestor and two descendants, lineage metadata and a matching annotated reference. Three unrelated isolates do not establish ancestor-relative change.
proposed_artifact_requirements: samples.tsv: sample_id, lineage_role, ancestor_id, source_run, preprocessing
alignments/: BAM/BAI per line
calls/: normalized VCF/TBI and filter evidence per line
callable.bed and callable_status.tsv: sample_id, interval, reason
lineage_variants.tsv: chrom, pos, ref, alt, ancestor_genotype, descendant_a_genotype, descendant_b_genotype, callable_in_all, shared_derived, status
consequences.tsv: chrom, pos, ref, alt, gene, transcript_id, impact, effect, threshold_pass
source_specific_decisions: Haploid caller, read/quality/strand filters, indel normalization, common callable territory and missing-call semantics.
Ancestor subtraction, shared-allele equality, annotation version, MODERATE-or-higher consequence ordering and multi-transcript handling.
deterministic_verification_approach: Execute aligner, native caller, allele normalization and annotation; retain all stages.
Independently compare full allele keys (chromosome, position, reference and alternate), lineage states and filter logic; a shared coordinate without the same allele does not pass.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Treat an uncallable ancestor as absence.
Intersect positions while alternate alleles differ.
Return a descendant-private or low-impact allele as shared derived.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: Shared derived alleles do not alone establish adaptation, causality or an evolutionary rate.
Previously planned generic isolate comparison omitted the ancestor and shared-consequence endpoint; those inputs/stages are mandatory.
questions.independent_input_decision: Select an independent observed nonpathogenic lineage experiment with archived ancestor/descendant reads and documented descent, outside source studies.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Use complete small-genome references and realistic observed coverage; avoid choosing reads or loci by known variant outcome. Measure all three alignment/calling paths and the full comparison.

questions.scientific_question: Which diploid germline calls from independently observed exome reads agree with a separate high-confidence reference within declared capture and callable regions?
required_endpoint_stages: validate sample/build/capture identity
align exome reads against an appropriately complete reference
call diploid germline variants with native tools
normalize calls and preserve genotype/filter evidence
compare to private high-confidence calls using a representation-aware evaluator within declared territory
observed_input_requirements: Observed diploid human exome reads from a sample distinct from the source benchmark sample, matching genome build, capture BED and independent high-confidence VCF/BED evaluation evidence. Bacterial reads cannot support this endpoint.
proposed_artifact_requirements: reads.tsv and alignment_qc.tsv: sample_id, source_run, build, pairs, mapping/duplicate/coverage measures
calls.vcf.gz and index: all required diploid genotypes, alleles and filter fields
evaluation_regions.bed: capture/callable/high-confidence intersection under an explicit boundary convention
comparison.vcf.gz: match/mismatch attribution from the pinned evaluator
metrics.tsv: variant_type, region_stratum, truth_total, query_total, TP, FP, FN, precision, recall, f1
source_specific_decisions: Sample, genome build, capture panel, ploidy regions, duplicate policy, caller/filter settings and variant representation normalization.
Evaluator version, haplotype/genotype matching, region-boundary behavior, filtered-call policy, type strata and zero-denominator rules.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run native aligner and diploid caller; run pinned hap.py or an equivalent explicitly specified representation-aware evaluator.
Independently check call schema/alleles/genotypes, exact region intersection and all metric denominators; keep truth inaccessible to the solver.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Swap truth sample or build.
Match only chromosome/position while genotype or allele differs.
Count calls outside evaluation territory as true positives; copy private truth into the input package.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: A bounded observed exome subset does not establish whole-exome or whole-genome performance.
The source threshold score does not justify accepting incomplete VCFs or omitting hard regions; freeze the authored criterion before solver trials.
questions.independent_input_decision: Resolve an independent public exome sample and matched high-confidence/capture evidence; audit overlap with all ID/OOD source descriptions without inspecting OOD biological fixtures.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Use an explicit coherent capture-region start boundary with read-pair provenance and a complete alignment reference to avoid restricted-reference mapping artifacts. Keep cohort/region scale and missing coverage visible; measure the full run.

questions.scientific_question: How do taxonomic abundance profiles differ between two independently observed community samples after paired-read QC and ambiguity-aware classification?
required_endpoint_stages: audit both paired-read libraries and controls
apply identical read eligibility/QC
classify both samples using the same native database
reconcile taxon IDs and ranks including unclassified/ambiguous reads
compute abundance under declared denominators and export the complete joined profiles
observed_input_requirements: Observed shotgun reads from two documented community conditions, sample metadata and an offline versioned classifier database/taxonomy. Supplied count tables do not cover native read classification.
proposed_artifact_requirements: samples.tsv: sample_id, condition, source_run, biological_unit, extraction_or_batch
read_qc.tsv: sample_id, input_pairs, retained_pairs, classified_pairs, ambiguous_pairs, unclassified_pairs
classifier_outputs/: native per-read assignments and reports
taxonomy.tsv: taxon_id, parent_id, rank, scientific_name, kingdom, phylum, database_version
abundances.tsv: taxon_id, rank, sample_a_count, sample_b_count, sample_a_fraction, sample_b_fraction, denominator_a, denominator_b, eligible
comparisons.tsv: taxon_id, absolute_difference, declared_ratio, zero_policy
source_specific_decisions: Read versus pair counting, classification confidence, taxonomy/rank version, ancestor aggregation and ambiguous/unclassified policy.
Total-read versus classified-read denominators, abundance estimator and zero handling; retain distinct sample columns.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run the native classifier/abundance estimator on actual reads against the exact frozen reference.
Independently reconcile read totals, taxon hierarchy, rank aggregation and both abundance columns; validate all taxa rather than a few matching taxon names.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Swap the sample columns.
Drop unclassified reads from the denominator silently.
Double-count ancestor/descendant ranks or corrupt a low-abundance taxon while preserving the top taxon.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: Two unreplicated libraries support descriptive composition comparison, not population-level inference about treatment.
Detected sequence assignments do not establish viable organisms or causal condition effects; measured composition truth is separate when unavailable.
questions.independent_input_decision: Select independent observed environmental or benign community samples with comparable processing and a feasible reference database; preserve biological sample roles.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Provide a prebuilt offline database with exact inclusion rules. Any bounded database changes the scientific search universe and must be declared; use observed read subsets that retain realistic ambiguity and community complexity.

questions.scientific_question: Which cell types show reproducible transcriptional differences between independently observed paired conditions after raw-count QC, clustering and annotation?
required_endpoint_stages: audit raw layers, feature identities and sample pairing
perform cell/gene QC and normalization
compute representation, graph and clusters
annotate clusters with declared reference/marker evidence
fit donor-aware within-cell-type condition contrasts
export full marker, annotation and gene-contrast tables
observed_input_requirements: Observed 10x/AnnData raw counts with documented before/after conditions, donor pairing, sample/batch IDs and independent cell-identity reference or marker evidence. A single unlabeled PBMC matrix does not supply the condition comparison.
proposed_artifact_requirements: cells.tsv: cell_id, sample_id, donor_id, condition, cluster_id, predicted_cell_type, qc_pass, annotation_evidence
features.tsv: feature_id, gene_name, mitochondrial, eligible
representation/: PCA loadings, neighbor graph and per-cell embedding coordinates
pseudobulk.tsv: cell_type, donor_id, condition, gene_id, count, contributing_cells
effects.tsv: cell_type, contrast, gene_id, gene_name, logfoldchanges, pvals, pvals_adj, direction, abs_logfc, eligible
cluster_effects.tsv: cluster_id, predicted_cell_type, gene_name, effect_reference, ambiguity_or_exclusion
source_specific_decisions: QC/normalization/feature rules, graph and clustering settings, annotation evidence hierarchy and ambiguous labels.
Documented donor pairing, cell-type eligibility and count aggregation, model design, contrast direction and complete tested-gene universe; never treat cells as independent donors.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run the chosen native Scanpy/Seurat pipeline and a native donor-level count model on actual observed counts.
Independently reconstruct QC and pseudobulk counts, sample pairing and all gene/contrast results; check cluster labels by membership/evidence rather than literal numeric cluster IDs.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Return a matching cluster label but no expression results.
Leak condition labels into reference annotation; fabricate paired donors.
Reverse contrast direction without changing signed effects or p-value membership.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: The source asks about exercise in skeletal muscle. A different observed tissue/condition can cover the pipeline stages but cannot establish that biological response.
Donor-level inference deliberately replaces pseudoreplicated cell tests; record methodological adaptation when the original prompt does not fix the statistical unit.
questions.independent_input_decision: Prefer independent observed paired skeletal-muscle/exercise data with genuine donor replication; if another condition is selected, preserve the unmatched source context as a limitation.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Bound features/cells using documented sample-preserving rules; keep every biological donor and condition. Measure preprocessing, annotation and all within-cell-type models together.

questions.scientific_question: Which transcript abundances and ambiguity estimates result from native quantification of independently observed paired RNA reads?
required_endpoint_stages: audit pair/library orientation and transcript identities
quantify the reads with a pinned native transcript estimator
retain effective lengths, estimated counts and abundance units
export the complete transcript universe and ambiguity/assignment diagnostics
observed_input_requirements: Observed paired RNA FASTQ plus a versioned compatible transcriptome FASTA and transcript-to-gene map; include realistic isoform ambiguity. GFF extraction alone is not transcript quantification.
proposed_artifact_requirements: reads.tsv: source_run, read_pairs, orientation, qc_policy
transcripts.tsv: transcript_id, gene_id, sequence_length, reference_version
quantification.tsv: transcript_id, effective_length, estimated_count, TPM, eligible, uncertainty_when_requested
summary.tsv: input_pairs, processed_pairs, mapped_or_assigned_pairs, assigned_mass, unmapped_or_ambiguous_mass, library_type
native_quant/: complete native estimator output and parameter/index manifest
source_specific_decisions: Transcript reference/decoys, native tool/version, library type, bias settings, count unit (fragments versus reads), bootstrap/uncertainty policy and zero-length rules.
Do not round estimated fractional counts to invented exact observed transcript counts. Freeze numerical tolerances from native repeatability and independent accounting, before solver runs.
deterministic_verification_approach: Run actual Salmon or kallisto with the declared library/reference settings; emit every transcript including zero estimates.
Independently check identity completeness, effective-length use, abundance normalization and assignment accounting. Native estimated counts are an algorithmic reference, not measured molecule truth.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Replace estimated counts by TPM.
Duplicate transcript IDs or drop zero-count isoforms.
Round fractional assignments to integers or count both mates as independent fragments.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: The original source uses simulated reads and demands exact latent counts. Real observed reads generally cannot reveal exact latent isoform counts.
This task transfers native abundance estimation and artifact accounting; exact recovery of simulated molecule truth remains outside the observed-data adaptation.
questions.independent_input_decision: Select independent real paired RNA reads with a compact compatible transcriptome and nontrivial isoforms; resolve source-study overlap and reference naming.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Package the offline native index and reference manifest. Bound observed read pairs without erasing ambiguity; record preprocessing as the task start boundary and measure native estimation plus checks.

questions.scientific_question: Which assembled contigs from an independently observed community have supported viral assignments, and how do complete domain/species counts follow from those assignments?
required_endpoint_stages: audit read pairing and perform QC
assemble observed reads with a native assembler
map reads back to every contig for support
classify every eligible contig with native sequence evidence
reconcile ambiguous/unclassified assignments
aggregate complete contig counts by domain and species
observed_input_requirements: Observed community paired reads with multiple sequence origins and a pinned offline viral/general classification reference. A single PhiX control cannot supply the community-assembly endpoint.
proposed_artifact_requirements: read_qc.tsv: sample_id, input_pairs, retained_pairs, filters
contigs.fasta and contigs.tsv: contig_id, length, coverage, eligible, exclusion_reason
classification.tsv: contig_id, database_version, reference_hit, evidence_score, taxon_id, rank, domain, species, ambiguity_status
support.tsv: contig_id, aligned_reads, breadth, depth, discordance
species_summary.tsv: domain, species, contig_count, unclassified_policy
source_specific_decisions: Assembler version/parameters, minimum contig length, read-support rules, reference content, classifier score thresholds and multi-hit rank reconciliation.
One contig/one summary-count contribution under explicit ambiguity rules; retain excluded and unclassified counts separately.
deterministic_verification_approach: Execute actual assembler, mapper and classifier; consume full observed reads and reference metadata.
Independently verify contig identity/length/support and aggregation of every classification row; a single named species is insufficient.

source_artifact_contracts.inspection: Original question/description reviewed; illustrative answer rows and reference results are not training data.

negative_artifact_checks: Report a species without supporting contigs.
Count multiple hits from one contig as multiple contigs.
Drop unclassified contigs or claim a species from insufficient taxonomic resolution.
endpoint_fidelity_limits: Taxonomic read/contig evidence cannot prove the cause of illness or infectious viability.
An independent benign community exercises assembly/classification; the original host-associated disease context remains distinct.
questions.independent_input_decision: Choose independent observed benign environmental/phage-community sequencing with sufficient complexity, without using source samples or known expected species as selection targets.
questions.bounded_runtime_design: Use a documented realistic observed read subset and prebuilt local classification reference; measure QC, assembly, read-back mapping and full classification within 30 minutes.
